newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania reviews taxes in 1997/98 budget.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania reviews taxes in 1997/98 budget.

text.p: Tanzania on Thursday unveiled its 1997/98 budget. Finance Minister Daniel Yona said customs duty would be streamlined, with the maximum rate being cut to 30 percent from 40 percent while that of sales tax would be cut to 25 percent from 30 percent

Yona said a five percent sales tax will be applied to gas oil and liquefied petroleum gas while excise duty on lubricants and premium petrol will be raised by 15.85 Tanzanian shillings. Mining firms will be exempted of all taxes on imported machinery and equipment for five years.
